title: MITC8 thick Navier plate, 16 x 16 quarter mesh (32 x 32 equivalent full mesh)
source: C. W. Bert and C. C. Siu, NASA CR-112140 (1972), §§2.2–2.6 and 4.1, https://ntrs.nasa.gov/citations/19720022240; separated Navier amplitudes derived in README, with this case's fixed 5/6 shear factor; static separated solution and thickness moments derived in README

quantities.reason: Fixed 3% reference tolerance. This 16 x 16 quarter model is equivalent to a 32 x 32 full mesh; full 4/8/16 meshes failed and are explicitly reported in README, not counted as passes.
